players.product: behind-the-meter natural-gas turbine power generation with balance of plant, batteries and O&M for data centers (Power Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: Solaris's 8-K: on September 1, 2026 it acquired Omega Foundation Services, a specialized engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firm with significant expertise in heavy civil construction across multiple end markets, including large-scale data centers; the deal adds early-stage site services and electrical substation development to Solaris' full-cycle power offering and brings growth opportunities in the data center, LNG, industrial and government sectors. Co-CEOs Bill Zartler and Amanda Brock: Solaris has worked alongside the Omega team for two years in multiple locations; 'we have significant near-term opportunities for long-term contracted power growth with new and existing customers' and look forward to announcing several further business expansions in the coming months.
